narr: A deep plume of early season monsoonal moisture moved up areas east of the Rio Grande Valley. At the same time, an upper trough was entering the Great Basin helping to trigger numerous storms with heavy rain across the Rio Grande Valley of Dona Ana and Otero counties.
ev: The Orogrande Gate on the White Sands Missile Range received 4.62 of rain and caused some portions of the road from Highway 54 to get flooded.
Highway 185 was reported to be impassable between mile markers 25 and 30.
Another round of storms in the day brought flash flooding to areas of Highway 185 about 5 miles south-southeast of Rincon with several low water crossings impassable.
Workers on the White Sands Missile Range reported Flash Flooding near the intersection of Range Road Route 7 and 10.
lsr: WSMR personnel report flash flooding along Range Road 7 near the intersection of Range Road 10.
WSMR Station WSM18 at Orogrande Gate reports 4.62 inches of rain in two hours. Verified by radar estimates.
NM 185 at milepost 25 & 30 impassible due to water running over roadways. Crews working to clear road.
Several Low Water Crossing are impassable along NM 185.
